$comment: Machine-readable facts for LCM 3D Navigation AI (LCM Nav3D). Every value is counted from the shipped 3.6.0 plugin; the counting method for each is in the author's claims sheet. Pages on uedevlabs.github.io quote these values.

product.name: LCM 3D Navigation AI
product.category: Unreal Engine plugin: volumetric 3D navigation and pathfinding
product.author: L. Charitha Madhushanka
product.fabTitle: LCM 3D Navigation AI - Infinite 3D Pathfinding & Volumetric Navigation for UE5

featured.title: Best 3D Navigation Plugin on the Marketplace
featured.author: VecFourDigital
featured.quote: Nothing compares to this. Got drones working for my prototype in a few hours.

compatibility.platformsNote: Consoles build from source with your own platform SDK. Nintendo Switch support is in progress.
compatibility.source: Complete C++ source, fully exposed to Blueprint; no C++ required

navigation.representation: Sparse voxel octree of navigable volume (empty air and water), not a walkable surface
worldModes: Finite (built or baked to an asset)
Infinite (chunks stream around agents, with pre-baked chunks and a persistent long-range graph)
navigation.gpu: GPU-built navigation on by default: voxelization, chunk octrees, their links, finite-world builds and obstacle re-tests run on the GPU (D3D12, D3D11, Vulkan; SM5 and SM6)
navigation.gpuVoxelizationCheck: With Voxelization Method Auto, each machine's GPU proves its voxels before it builds navigation; a GPU that fails voxelizes on the CPU for that session
navigation.gpuPathSolving: Per-agent GPU path solver in experimental validation; coming as a free update
navigation.costAreas: Storms, preferred lanes, toll gates and no-fly zones with stock NavArea classes, priced per agent with Navigation Query Filters
navigation.dynamicObstacles: Moving geometry restamps the octree and agents re-route live; Fly To predicts each mover and times its pass

ai.flyToLocationNode: A latent Blueprint node that flies any pawn with no Behavior Tree, StateTree or AI Controller
ai.stockNavigation: Unreal's own Move To, AI Move To and EQS plan through the octree
ai.crowdScale: 10,000+ agents through Mass Entity (per-agent paths or a shared flow field)

content.demoBreakdown: 17 worlds in Behavior Tree and StateTree editions (34), 15 Mass Entity editions, 8 Feature Examples levels
content.demoDelivery: Free, from inside the editor: LCM Nav3D menu > Get the Demo Levels
